# Synthetic progressive JPEG

`synthetic-progressive.jpg` contains no customer data or identifying metadata.
Generated with Pillow 12.3.0: RGB 64×48, pixel at `(x,y)` =
`((17*x+3*y)%256, (19*y+x)%256, (7*x+13*y)%256)`, JPEG quality 85,
`progressive=True`. SHA-256:
`5ef57c7b8983e6b1e081582ac7fb98d786975dce687839a683b47f9f3d3250ef`.

Other corpus inputs are deterministically generated by `helpers/jpeg-corpus.mjs`.
Large images are generated locally rather than committed. An Images metadata
test double is not evidence of actual Cloudflare decoding or security.
